basic_details.job_title: TMC HBCH Varanasi Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Senior Resident post in the Department of Surgical Oncology (Gynecological Oncology) at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi is open to Indian Nationals. The post is tenure-based up to 31 July 2027, with monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,40,238/- depending on level. Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai (a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Govt. of India) takes applications online at tmc.gov.in until 5 December 2026, 5:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online using Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI. It is not refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 1 post in total. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to cancel or increase/decrease the number of advertised posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The vacancy table asks for MS/MD (Obstetrics & Gynecology) or an equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC. The salary table sets the level of Senior Resident by experience. The maximum age limit is 45 years. Age and experience are reckoned as on 05.12.2026. The relaxation applies as per applicable rules. Only Indian Nationals may apply. Candidates awaiting their result may apply, where applicable, but must produce proof of having passed the required degree at the MCQ/interview. All undergraduate, postgraduate and super-specialty degrees must be recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post is tenure-based for a fixed period up to 31.07.2027, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre. A security deposit is listed for each designation: Rs. 1,33,623/- (Senior Resident I), Rs. 1,36,269/- (Senior Resident II) and Rs. 1,40,238/- (Senior Resident III). Senior Resident may be provided shared accommodation, subject to availability. Hostel charges, wherever applicable, are deducted monthly from the stipend/salary. No TA/DA is admissible to candidates appearing for the MCQ/interview. Candidates selected and appointed to HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi must be registered with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online using Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI. It is not refunded under any circumstances.

rows.category: SC / ST / Female candidates / Persons with Disabilities / Ex-servicemen (1st time applying for civil post after serving any rank)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice mentions an MCQ examination and an interview. The MCQ examination may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting; the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi decides this and the decision is final. The notice does not print the MCQ pattern, dates or venue. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to cancel the post, to prescribe minimum eligibility standards/benchmarks and to restrict the number of candidates called for the MCQ/interview based on the number of vacancies and candidates' performance. It may also prescribe minimum standards or cut-off marks, including group/stream/discipline/category-wise cut-offs, for shortlisting for the interview and for final selection after the interview. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not give a right to be called. The Director's decision, HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi is final.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Varanasi Senior Resident
content_sections.text: Open the online application link on the Tata Memorial Centre website: https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers . Complete the prescribed online application form in all respects. Incomplete applications are rejected. Upload the No Objection Certificate (NOC) as part of the online application if you are currently employed by a government or government-related organisation. Pay the Rs. 300/- fee online by Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI, unless exempted. Submit the application by 05.12.2026, 5:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time). A hard copy need not be sent, and no other mode of application is accepted. A separate application must be submitted for each post. Provide your latest mobile number and a valid e-mail ID: all correspondence is made through the e-mail ID [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Documentary evidence in support of the application, along with any other relevant documents. Missing documents make the application incomplete and it is summarily rejected. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, issued through the Head of the Institution/Department and uploaded with the online application, for candidates currently employed by a Central/State Government, autonomous body or semi-government organisation. Original NOC, to be produced at the MCQ test/interview. Proof of having passed the required degree, to be produced at the MCQ/interview by candidates awaiting result.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Failure to produce the original NOC disallows the candidate from appearing for the MCQ test/interview. Candidates who fail to produce proof of passing the required degree are not permitted to appear for the MCQ/interview. An application is rejected if incorrect or false information is given; no correspondence is entertained. TMC reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. The Centre is not responsible for non-receipt of communications due to online submission errors, incorrect e-mail IDs or e-mails landing in spam/bulk folders. Any dispute is subject to the exclusive legal jurisdiction of Varanasi.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there at TMC Varanasi?
faq.answer: There is 1 Senior Resident post in the Department of Surgical Oncology (Gynecological Oncology) at HBCH and MPMMCC, Varanasi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 05.12.2026, up to 5:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Senior Resident?
faq.answer: MS/MD (Obstetrics & Gynecology) or an equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC. Senior Resident II needs 1 year and Senior Resident III needs 2 years of experience in oncology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 05.12.2026, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PwD, as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration?
faq.answer: Rs. 1,33,623/- for Senior Resident I, Rs. 1,36,269/- for Senior Resident II and Rs. 1,40,238/- for Senior Resident III.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300/-, paid online by Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. SC, ST, female candidates, PwD and ex-servicemen (1st time applying for a civil post after serving any rank) are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers. No hard copy is needed and no other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a tenure-based position for a fixed period up to 31.07.2027, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre.

faq.question: Q9. Do government employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently employed by a government or government-related organisation must upload an NOC with the online application and produce the original at the MCQ test/interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA given for the MCQ or interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is admissible to candidates appearing for the MCQ/interview.
